claims.claim: You must register for Council Tax at a new address.
claims.quote: If you move to a new property or to a new area, tell your local council or tell the council for the new area you’ve moved to.
claims.note: The national guidance directs movers to notify a council, which registers them and sends a bill.

claims.claim: You must close your Council Tax account at your old address.
claims.quote: We will close your Leeds council tax account and issue a final bill or refund.
claims.note: Leeds describes closing its own account, but this local process does not establish a universal requirement for every council.

claims.claim: Various Council Tax discounts may apply.
claims.quote: This means you might be able to apply for a discount on your Council Tax bill if you get one.
claims.note: The page describes multiple discount categories and possible eligibility.
